entries.back_en: As you wish. I'll do it myself. Stay quiet (masc.) while I free her/it from this suffering.
entries.note: Gender inconsistency: 'quieto' (masc.) but 'a liberto' (fem./it); source 'you' ambiguous. Use 'livro você'.

entries.back_en: You're more resistant than the others, but to me you're no more than a worm trying to escape an apple.
Liandris, help me trap that soldier. His strength threatens our plans.
Sangrigor? What are you talking about? What are you doing?
We must spread the Dark Plague to every corner of this world. That is our purpose.
Sangrigor, it's not you talking, it's one of the parasites.
I see... You don't understand anything either, just like the others.
You think it's a parasite controlling me? That I'm doing this because I'm a puppet?
entries.note: Accurate; 'sou fantoche' omits article but fine.

entries.back_en: Quickly, Liandris! Take it! He will show you the truth! Do it!
I thought you would listen to me, but I won't give up until I break your chains.
